aiChat.question: Create a professional Finrival comparison report for GOOGL vs MSFT using the 5Y data window.
aiChat.note: This analysis is provided for informational purposes only and does not constitute financial advice.
aiChat.followHint: Tapping only prepares the question. Send requests a new answer.
aiChat.disclaimer: AI can make mistakes. Not investment advice.
aiChat.headline: The supplied 5-year historical snapshot shows a trade-off between higher standalone growth for Alphabet and stronger relative common-date risk metrics for Microsoft.
aiChat.d1: Alphabet achieved a higher 5-year historical CAGR of 19.02% compared to Microsoft's 11.49%.
aiChat.d2: Microsoft led Alphabet by 21.3 percentage points over their shared timeline while sitting at a series high.
aiChat.d3: Microsoft demonstrated lower annualized volatility (27.82% versus 29.66%) and a smaller maximum drawdown (37.56% versus 44.32%) than Alphabet.
aiChat.d4: A 0.44 return correlation indicates moderate price co-movement rather than identical price action or total diversification assurance.
aiChat.r1: Alphabet suffered notably deeper historical drawdowns, whereas Microsoft's higher RSI14 (62.98) reflects recent momentum rather than a forecast of future gains.
aiChat.w1: A sustained relative return convergence or a widening gap in drawdown metrics during market pullbacks would shift the comparative risk-adjusted balance.

proPage.q1: Do I need PRO to use Finrival?
proPage.a1: Not at all, Market, Compare, News, Rival, a watchlist of 5 assets and 5 AI requests a day are free
proPage.a2: Any time in your App Store or Google Play subscription settings, and PRO stays active until the end of the period you paid for
proPage.q3: Can I use PRO on more than one device?
proPage.a3: Yes, sign in with the same account to unlock PRO across your devices
proPage.q4: How many AI requests does PRO include?
proPage.a4: PRO gives you 10× the Free plan's daily AI requests, and the allowance resets every day; fair-use limits keep the service fast and reliable for everyone
proPage.q5: I reinstalled the app, how do I get PRO back?
proPage.a5: Use Restore Purchases in the app, or sign in with the account you used before
proPage.q6: Does PRO add trading or investment advice?
proPage.a6: No, PRO adds depth to your research, Finrival never places trades or gives personal investment advice

supportPage.title: How can we help?
supportPage.lead: Account, privacy, deletion, PRO or something not working, write to us and a person will read it
supportPage.contactBody: Describe the issue clearly and include only what we need to understand it
supportPage.contactWarn: Never send passwords, card details, private keys or seed phrases by email
supportPage.t1Body: Email verification, access problems and account questions
supportPage.t2Body: How Finrival handles data and how to use your rights

supportPage.t6Body: Market, Compare, Rival, Watchlist, News and Finrival AI
supportPage.q1: I think someone accessed my account
supportPage.a1: Email support@finrival.com as soon as you can, and we may ask for reasonable verification before making sensitive account changes
supportPage.q2: How do I ask about my data or use my privacy rights?
supportPage.a2: Write to the same support address and see the Privacy Policy for what we process and why, deletion requests start on the Delete Account page
supportPage.q3: How do subscriptions, cancellations and refunds work?
supportPage.a3: Purchases are handled by the App Store or Google Play, so cancellation, billing and refunds follow their rules, and deleting the app or your account doesn't cancel an active subscription
supportPage.q4: A price looks wrong or an alert came late
supportPage.a4: Market data can be delayed, cached or incomplete and alerts can be delayed or missed, so don't use Finrival as your only source for time-sensitive decisions
supportPage.q5: Finrival AI gave a wrong answer
supportPage.a5: AI can be incorrect, incomplete or outdated and is never personal financial, tax or legal advice, so report the answer from the chat and leave personal details out of any email
supportPage.q6: Does Finrival ever see my card details?
supportPage.a6: No, the App Store and Google Play process payments and Finrival never receives your full card details
